composition_variation: Feature Sanji in a bright seaside bakery, recognizable blond hair and curled eyebrow, dressed in a crisp white shirt, black trousers, and a blue striped apron. He holds a small tray with one golden loaf, smiling with easy hospitality. Use graphic cobalt and butter-yellow blocks, fine flour textures, and angled dawn light. Omit cigarettes, lettering, sharp tools, and background staff. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
